units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:2:6">Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>פְּחוּת מאכל</he> (not <he>מאוכל</he>) a small quantity of food (corresp. to ib. I, 2 <he>מעוטו</he>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:9">Men. XI, 9</cite> <he>אין פ׳ משנים</he> no less than two days (after being baked); <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:9">ib.</cite> <he>אין פ׳ מתשעה ולא יתר וכ׳</he> no less than nine days, nor more than eleven; <cite ref="Pesachim 47a:1">Pes. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>לא פ׳ ולא יותר</he> no less (than nine), nor more (than eleven).
Meg. 21ᵇ אין משיירין בפרשה פ׳ וכ׳ in distributing the readings of a Scriptural portion we must leave for the last reader no less than three verses; a. v. fr.—Fem. פְּחוּתָה.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 1</cite> <he>ערבה שהיא פ׳ וכ׳</he> a kneading trough which contains less than &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּחוּתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:2">Keth. I, 2</cite> <he>פ׳ מבנות שלש וכ׳</he> when they were less than three years and one day old; a. fr.

senses.gloss: inferior. Tanḥ. T’rum. 7 נחשת כנגד … שהיא פ׳ מכולם ‘copper’ (Ex. XXV, 3) corresponding to the Greek (Syrian) empire, which was the meanest of all of them; a. fr.
